scientific_boundary: The nested-cylinder transport theorem is all-depth exact. The actual return table is finite through depth 14 and the absence of three-return candidates is finite through complexity 25. This does not prove an all-depth three-return obstruction, phase-complexity divergence, exclusion of eventual center period two, or Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.

theorem.consecutive_blocks: Several zero-penalty blocks survive exactly when one current residual minimizer begins with their concatenated base-four digits; the consumed digits are shifted away after each block.
theorem.same_complexity_transport: If X'=X+4^L c with 0<=c<4^r, then C_(a,k)(X',L+r) is the subset of C_(a,k)(X,L) whose residual x>>(2L) is congruent to c modulo 4^r.
theorem.zero_penalty: For k=kappa_a(X,L), the extension penalty is zero exactly when the transported current minimizer set is nonempty; in that case the transported set is the complete new minimizer set.
